tools.name: estimate_vram
tools.description: GPU memory, number of GPUs, speed and rental cost to run an open LLM. Works for the models listed at https://studiotvai.com/api/models.json and any Hugging Face model id or link. Uses the real KV cache of each architecture (sliding window, hybrid linear attention, MLA).

tools.name: models_that_fit
tools.description: Every listed open model that fits on the given GPU(s), largest first, with the most faithful weight format that fits.

tools.name: gpu_prices
tools.description: Cheapest on-demand price per GPU-hour from AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, RunPod, Vast.ai, Oracle Cloud, OVHcloud, Scaleway, Verda, Akash and UpCloud, checked every hour.
